ui.startup.title: Startup could not be completed
ui.startup.help: Check your settings and connected devices, resolve the problem, and try again.
ui.update.waiting: Waiting for current work to finish before closing the app for an update.
ui.general.sharedShortcuts: Shortcuts can be shared with other apps. Their actions may run at the same time.
ui.settings.title: Minus700K — Settings
ui.general.cancelHelp: Also discards a question being recorded without sending it.
ui.general.replayHelp: Reads the most recent answer again.
ui.general.captureHelp: Captures the active window when you start speaking and attaches the image to your question.
ui.general.imageWidthHelp: Larger images are resized to this width before sending.
ui.general.captureFailureHelp: After you release the key, announces that your question will continue without an image.
ui.general.captureFallbackHelp: Your spoken question continues even if screen capture fails. A different recording sound lets you know that no image was captured.
ui.audio.exclusiveMicrophoneHelp:
Microphone input to other apps is disabled while recording.
If it cannot be disabled, audio is not recorded.
ui.audio.speaker: Speaker
ui.audio.volumeHelp: Works alongside the app volume setting in Windows.
ui.audio.otherApplicationVolumeHelp: Percentage of the original volume: 100 leaves it unchanged; 0 silences it. Restored when the answer finishes or is canceled.
ui.audio.routingHelp: Uses Windows output settings when the selected speaker is unavailable.
ui.audio.processingCuesHelp: Plays a soft tone while waiting for an answer.
ui.search.title: Web search settings
ui.search.modeHelp:
“When needed” searches the web when your question includes a web search keyword.
“Use cached web information only” uses information already collected by the service.
ui.search.fallback: Search again if information is missing
ui.search.fallbackHelp: If the first attempt cannot provide a sufficient answer, enables web search and tries once more.
ui.search.keywordsHelp: Enter one keyword per line. When a question includes a keyword, web search is enabled for that question only.
ui.search.voicePriority: Spoken instructions such as “don't search the web” take priority over keywords.
ui.instructions.help: Set your preferences for answer length, tone and style.
ui.instructions.overrideHelp: These instructions apply to every question. You can ask for something different, such as more detail, in an individual question.
ui.history.title: Recent exchanges
ui.history.count: Recent exchanges to keep in application memory
ui.history.countHelp:
The previous conversation is temporarily stored in memory and passed to the AI during the next conversation.
This information is used to help the AI understand the conversational context and maintain continuity.
ui.history.debugHelp: Saves full diagnostic data locally, including questions, answers, recorded audio, available images, text read aloud, and processing results.
ui.history.retentionHelp:
Saved diagnostic files are not deleted automatically.
Keep an eye on the disk space they use.
ui.history.openFolderError: Could not open the saved files folder. {0}
ui.advanced.answerTimeoutHelp:
How long to wait for the AI service.
The request is cancelled if it exceeds this time.
ui.advanced.whisperTimeoutHelp:
How long to wait for speech recognition.
Processing is cancelled if it exceeds this time.
ui.advanced.maximumRecordingHelp: Recordings longer than this limit are not processed.
ui.advanced.minimumRecordingHelp: Recordings shorter than this limit are not processed.
ui.advanced.threadsHelp: More threads also use more CPU resources.
ui.advanced.codexPathHelp: Leave blank to detect automatically, or enter the path to codex.exe.
ui.advanced.codexModelHelp: Usually left blank. When set, overrides the model selected on the Connection tab.
ui.advanced.applicationInstructionsHelp:
Applies to every question, whether custom instructions are on or off.
Select Save and apply to use your changes.
ui.connection.busy: Wait for the connection operation to finish before saving.
ui.audio.sample: This is a test of the Minus700K volume and speaking speed.
ui.audio.voiceError: Could not play the voice sample. {0}
ui.audio.cueError: Could not play the sound effect. {0}
ui.shortcut.help: Click here, then press the key combination you want to use.
ui.connection.accountHelp: Uses the allowance included in your own ChatGPT plan.
ui.connection.modelHelp: Load the available models and choose one. Select Save and apply to use your choice.
ui.connection.usageHelp: View your ChatGPT plan's usage and limits in your browser.
ui.connection.pendingModel: Select Save and apply to use the selected model.
ui.connection.autoModelHelp: Automatic uses the first model in the list of available models.
ui.connection.autoModel: Automatic (first in the list of candidates)
ui.connection.previewAccount:
Your ChatGPT account
Connected to your ChatGPT plan
ui.connection.disconnected: Not connected — select Continue with ChatGPT to connect.
ui.connection.permissionNeeded: Not connected, or permission to use your plan is required.
ui.connection.modelBusy: Wait for the model list or connection operation to finish before saving.
ui.connection.accountChanged: The connected account has changed or signed out. Reload the available models before saving.
ui.connection.modelChanged: The saved model was changed by another operation. Reopen settings before choosing a model.
ui.connection.restoreChanged: The model being restored was changed by another operation.
ui.connection.restoreFailed: Could not apply settings or fully restore the previous model. Check the current model on the Connection tab.
ui.connection.loginCancelled: Sign-in cancelled. Select Continue with ChatGPT to start again.
ui.connection.failed: The connection operation failed. Please try again.
ui.connection.waitToConnect: Waiting for the current question to finish before connecting.
ui.connection.loginPrompt: Complete sign-in in your browser. Questions are paused while you sign in. You can cancel or restart sign-in at any time.
ui.connection.loginSucceeded: You're using your ChatGPT plan. Select Manage usage to check your usage and limits.
ui.connection.loginNotPermitted: Signed in, but permission to use your plan is missing. Select Continue with ChatGPT to open the permission screen.
ui.connection.restarting: Ending the previous sign-in attempt and starting again…
ui.connection.noAccount: There is no account to sign out of.
ui.connection.waitToSignOut: Waiting for the current question to finish before signing out.
ui.connection.signedOut: Signed out. You can sign in again using the saved registration.
ui.connection.signedOutLocally: Signed out on this device. Server-side disconnection could not be confirmed. Remove the connection in your ChatGPT settings.
ui.connection.loadingModels: Checking which models are available for this account…
ui.connection.catalogAccountChanged: The connected account has changed. Reload the available models.
ui.connection.modelAvailability: Actual availability is checked when you submit a question.
ui.language.title: Language
ui.language.label: Application language
ui.language.help: Also updates unchanged default instructions and search keywords, the speech recognition language, and the reading voice. Select Save and apply to apply these changes.
ui.connection.overrideModel: Model “{0}” is specified in advanced settings and takes priority.
